differences.a_observable: The recess around the blue card has soft, light-grey shadows.

differences.a_observable: The white background tiles have a warm, cream-colored tint.
differences.b_observable: The white background tiles are neutral grey with a cool blue undertone.

differences.a_observable: The camera angle is more top-down, reducing perspective distortion.
differences.b_observable: The camera is at a lower angle, increasing perspective distortion.
differences.fix: Adjust camera tilt to match the flatter perspective.

differences.a_observable: Deep, soft ambient occlusion shadows are visible between the tiles.
differences.b_observable: Crevice shadows are extremely faint, making the tiles look flat.
differences.fix: Enable or increase ambient occlusion strength in render settings.

differences.a_observable: The white tiles have a distinct cool, blue-tinted color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white tiles are neutral grey, lacking the cool color grading.
differences.fix: Adjust color temperature or add a blue color cast in post.

differences.a_observable: A noticeable vignette is present, with darker corners.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is uniform across the frame, lacking corner falloff.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect in post-production.

differences.a_observable: The blue tile has a matte texture with soft specular highlights on its edges.
differences.b_observable: The blue tile has a flat, uniform shader with no specular highlights.
differences.fix: Adjust roughness and specular settings of the blue material.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Add ambient occlusion and soft contact shadows to the tiles to match the depth and integration of the reference video.

differences.a_observable: The camera perspective is lower and closer to the blue card, showing less of the surrounding grid.
differences.b_observable: The camera is higher and further back, showing more of the grid at a steeper angle.
differences.fix: Adjust camera height, distance, and pitch to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast by the blue card onto the white surface are soft and highly diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are sharp and dark with high contrast edges.
differences.fix: Increase the light source size or adjust shadow diffusion settings.

differences.a_observable: The blue card has a matte, slightly desaturated royal blue color.
differences.b_observable: The blue card is highly saturated and vibrant.
